meta.title: Whale Girl Pet
meta.description: A whale-maid desktop pet ported from the 1024Store plugin market: full sprite animation with blink, joy, feed, play, sleep and wander states, drag to move, and a settings section for size, speed and language. Since 1.1.0 a companion layer: work-status poses, mood/affection/satiety, daily quests, check-in, 41 achievements, tap zones and proactive care.
